subject: Columbus School Renaming Controversy
overview: The Council approved resolutions regarding union negotiations and housing updates, while the majority of the meeting was devoted to emotional public testimony concerning the renaming of the Columbus School and the legacy of former principal Jean Barry Sutherland.

items.title: Opening Routine and Clerical Union Negotiations
items.summary: The Council requested an update from the administration regarding the status of contract negotiations with the clerical union staff.

items.title: 40B Project Update and Legal Costs
items.summary: Approved a resolution as amended to request a status update on current 40B applications, including a breakdown of legal costs and an estimated timeline for the completion of litigation.

items.title: Recognition for Frank Andre
items.summary: Approved a resolution to recognize the late Frank Andre for his commitment to Medford and recommended the placement of a commemorative plaque at 36 Salem Street.

items.title: Memorial for Fred Colangeli
items.summary: The Council held a moment of silence and dedicated the meeting to the memory of Fred 'Papa' Colangeli.

items.title: Maintenance of State-Owned Roads and Medians
items.summary: Approved a resolution to invite representatives from DCR, MassDOT, and the state delegation to discuss the lack of maintenance and trash pickup on state-owned roads.

items.title: McGlynn School Infrastructure Repairs
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide an update on the condition of Freedom Way and the completion of curbing repairs around the McGlynn School complex.

items.title: Prestige Car Wash Sign Petition
items.summary: Denied a petition to reverse a sign permit denial for Prestige Car Wash because the proposed LED sign violated ordinance restrictions on movement and height.

items.title: Armstrong Ambulance and EMS Week Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing May 16-22 as EMS Awards Week and commending Armstrong Ambulance for its community service and vaccination efforts.

items.title: Committee Reports: Parking and Zoning
items.summary: Approved reports from the Parking Commission and the Committee of the Whole regarding municipal parking policies and ongoing zoning code updates.

items.title: Columbus School Renaming and Public Participation
items.summary: Numerous residents and family members testified extensively about the legacy of former principal Jean Barry Sutherland, the renaming of the Columbus School, and allegations of bias and racial rhetoric within the selection committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Routine Business
items.summary: The Council approved the records of the May 4th and May 11th meetings and reviewed a response from Waste Management regarding the cleaning of recycling bins.
